---
name: compiler-bundled-libreoffice-fontconfig-cache
description: Prevention strategy for bundled-libreoffice-fontconfig-cache.
---

When rendering with the bundled LibreOfficeDev.app, pass its packaged FONTCONFIG_FILE and a per-render writable XDG_CACHE_HOME; keep CJK text native and validate the renderer environment before visual refinement.

Downstreamed: integrated into the current pipeline and supported by measured proof.
